//: Merge into the project's .claude/settings.json ALONGSIDE kb-sessionstart.settings.json (both are separate SessionStart hook entries, not a replacement for each other). Injects `forebrief status` at every session start ONLY when this repo is forebrief-enabled -- `command -v forebrief` on PATH AND `.forebrief/config.json` exists, the operational definition (forebrief's kb/spec/config-and-formats.md). Degrades to a silent no-op otherwise (NF6: forebrief's own host-repo-independence property) -- never an error banner on a repo that hasn't set it up.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && command -v forebrief >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f .forebrief/config.json ] && forebrief status 2>/dev/null; true
